evals.prompt: /skill:product-ask. Read-only product workflow state-trace. A complete papercut candidate pc-1111111111111111 accompanies an approved product route through product-grilling and product-prd. Both leaf owners complete their existing work without an explicit candidate-specific papercut outcome. In the requested fields, papercut-role is exactly `non-product-evidence` for this complete candidate, ledger-access means leaf-owner ledger access, settlement-call means helper invocation, and product-authority reports whether authority changed from its pre-scenario state. Emit exactly `snapshot:product-handoff|pc-id:<id>|papercut-role:<kind>|ledger-access:<kind>|settlement-call:<kind>|product-authority:<kind>` and no prose.
assertions: The same immutable originating PC-ID passes through both existing Product Handoffs
Papercut evidence remains outside PRD and product authority
Product leaf owners never access the papercut ledger
Ordinary product completion leaves the record open, makes no settlement call, and adds no workflow stage

evals.prompt: /skill:product-ask. Read-only product workflow terminal trace. The exact lowercase record ID `pc-2222222222222222` was bound at route intake; preserve that spelling byte-for-byte. The current leaf owner returns an explicit candidate-specific fixed result with an exact durable reference to product-ask. In the requested fields, settlement-owner is the actor that validates the PC-ID and invokes settlement; product-result reports whether papercut settlement changed the existing product result. Emit exactly `snapshot:product-papercut|pc-id:<id>|settlement-owner:<owner>|result:<kind>|settlement-calls:<count>|product-result:<kind>` and no prose.
assertions: Only product-ask validates and invokes settlement
Exactly one settlement call targets the unchanged originating PC-ID
The explicit candidate-specific fixed result and durable reference are required
Settlement does not alter product authority or the product outcome

evals.prompt: /skill:product-ask. Read-only product workflow terminal matrix. Evaluate these exact input labels: completed, prd-approval, p07-approval, paused, blocked, abandoned, authority-change-required, incomplete, mismatched, unrelated, narrow-authority, and helper-failure. Preserve each input label verbatim and in input order within its mapped list. In the requested fields, open lists ordinary, nonterminal, incomplete, mismatched, or unrelated cases; report-only lists narrower-authority or helper-failure cases; ledger-mutations is the changed-record count; product-authority reports whether papercut processing changed authority. Emit exactly `snapshot:product-papercut-matrix|open:<items>|report-only:<items>|ledger-mutations:<count>|product-authority:<kind>` and no prose.
assertions: Ordinary product outcomes and approvals never imply papercut settlement
Incomplete, mismatched, broad, global, and unrelated outcomes leave the record open
Narrow authority and helper failure are disclosed report-only/open without a successful mutation or retry
No case adds product authority, changes the product result, or changes a ledger record
